parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The search keyword. Fuzzy match on module names is supported.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The filter condition for Registry module status.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
The workspace type. Valid values:

- system: public module

- self: custom module

- shared: shared module

- community: community module

By default, all types are returned.
